name: sleep
description: Sleep only: each night as Garmin scored it (health.sleep-episode) and each night on the CPAP machine (health.cpap-session.dreamstation), without the rest of the health record. A reader asking about CPAP nights is asking about sleep. v5 adds health.cpap-session.dreamstation to v4. v4 named the same type as v3 and only reworded this description. v3 named the type under the domain taxonomy; v2 named sleep.episode, v1 health.sleep, which only the retired health ETL wrote.
